name: Izek Strazni
title: The Baron's Enforcer
summary: The Baron's bailiff and fist, a scarred brute with one ordinary arm and one that is scaled, clawed and hot to the touch. He has dreamed of a red-haired woman since he was a boy.

guest_build.note: His own stat block as the Baron's enforcer (a CR 5 brute with a fiendish arm). He joins the party only as Ireena's brother, once he knows the truth: he guards her door wherever she shelters and falls in behind her when she travels with the party (allies/izek:join_with_her, with_her). A foe's extra boss damage does not apply to him, only foes count as bosses.
